Two things must be kept apart, and the out-of-sample gate (`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them. What is invariant is the native-B floor: the confluence over-disperses about 3.4x against an independence null and replicates on unseen data. What is not invariant is the wiring: the coupling graph is contemporaneous (not a directed time-sequence) but non-stationary, a now-map rather than a fixed lattice.\n14\t\n15\t**How to use it.** See Architecture below for the stream configuration and run commands.\n16\t\n17\t## What it does\n18\t\n19\tForty-four domain streams -- spanning market microstructure, space weather,\n20\tgeophysics, atmospheric chemistry, biological chirality, astrophysical particle\n21\tfluxes, and gravitational-wave astronomy -- each map to specific IG primitive\n22\tfamilies. When primitives co-activate across streams simultaneously, a **B-state\n23\tevent** occurs (B = Both in Belnap FOUR logic: a dialetheic confluence where\n24\tmultiple structural channels converge).\n25\t\n26\tig-pulse captures these events and asks: which stream fired which primitive first?\n27\tWhat are the lag times? Which systems are coupled to which, at what strength, and in\n28\twhat structural order?\n29\t\n30\tThe answer is an empirical map of how our-scale reality couples across domains.\n31\tThe coupling is contemporaneous rather than a directed time-sequence: the lead-lag\n32\tflow between channels sits **below** a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`), so\n33\tthe system reads a standing valuation rather than forecasting. But standing is not\n34\tunchanging. The native-B confluence is invariant and replicates out-of-sample,\n35\twhile the specific coupling graph is non-stationary. See \"What is invariant, and\n36\twhat is not\" below.\n37\t\n38\t## Architecture\n39\t\n40\t```\n41\t┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n42\t│ -- `DomainStreamAggregator` fetches all 44 streams via public APIs\n80\t   (no keys required). Each stream's raw values are thresholded into IG primitive\n81\t   alert levels (0/1/2). A `DomainSignal` aggregates all primitive alerts for one\n82\t   observation cycle. Writes one `Snapshot` per cycle to `snapshots.jsonl`.\n83\t\n84\t2. **couple** -- Computes Pearson cross-correlation between all (stream, primitive)\n85\t   alert time series at lags 0 to max_lag. Only edges with |r| >= min_r and p <= max_p   are retained. Saves to `coupling.json`.\n86\t\n87\t3. **map** -- Renders the coupling graph as an ASCII adjacency matrix (primitives\n88\t   as edge labels), or as Graphviz DOT for rendering. Nodes are (stream, primitive)\n89\t   pairs. Saves to `graph.json`.\n90\t\n91\t4. **report** -- For a given B-state snapshot timestamp, reconstructs the propagation\n92\t   anatomy: the first activation time of each (stream, primitive) pair in the lookback\n93\t   window, ordered as a topological traversal of the implication tree.\n94\t\n95\t## Stream to primitive mapping\n96\t\n97\tEach stream maps to specific IG primitives through threshold-based alert rules\n98\t(0 = nominal, 1 = mild, 2 = strong):\n99\t\n100\t### Base streams (1-16)\n101\t\n102\t| # schedule\n181\t\n182\tThe B-state multiplier acts as a **topological mass coefficient** -- it scales the\n183\tstructural significance of nodes participating in dialetheic intersections:\n184\t\n185\t| Alerts | Multiplier | Interpretation |\n186\t|--------|-----------|----------------|\n187\t| 0 | 1.00x | Nominal -- no primitive channel active |\n188\t| 1 | 1.20x | Single primitive -- isolated activation |\n189\t| 2 | 1.35x | Dual primitive -- paired activation |\n190\t| >=3 | 1.50x | **B-state** -- dialetheic confluence |\n191\t\n192\tA B-state is not an \"error\" or \"anomaly.\" It is the mathematical signature of a node\n193\tin the adjacency matrix where orthogonal domain rules overlap, assigned the Belnap\n194\tvalue **B** (Both True and False) -- a stable fixed point of the FDE bi-lattice.\n195\t\n196\t## Usage\n197\t\n198\t```bash\n199\t# Collect one snapshot now\n200\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli collect --once\n201\t\n202\t# Run continuously format\n224\t\n225\t### `data/snapshots.jsonl`\n226\t\n227\tAppend-only JSON lines, one `Snapshot` per collection cycle:\n228\t\n229\t```json\n230\t{\n231\t  \"ts\": \"2026-06-22T04:38:43Z\",\n232\t invariant, and what is not\n276\t\n277\tTwo claims must be kept apart, because the out-of-sample gate\n278\t(`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them and only one survives. Fit the\n279\tcalibration and the coupling structure on the earlier portion of the stream, then\n280\ttest on the later, unseen portion.\n281\t\n282\t- **Invariant: the native-B floor.** The confluence replicates. Active-channel\n283\t  count runs about 3.4x over-dispersed against an independence null in both halves,\n284\t  each calibrated only on itself (`ig_pulse/dialetheia.py`). Our-scale reality does\n285\t  not resolve into isolated single-channel states; when it moves, it floods. That\n286\t  is the stable result.\n287\t\n288\t- **Not invariant: the wiring.** The coupling graph is non-stationary. Fit the\n289\t  residual coupling on the earlier half and it does not transfer to the later half\n290\t  (full-matrix correlation about +0.1, both-sign forks about -0.05; PC1's own share\n291\t  moves from ~15% to ~30%). The adjacency matrix is a now-map, not a fixed law.\n292\t  Earlier drafts of this README called it an \"unchanging adjacency matrix\" with\n293\t  \"edge invariants\" and \"structural constants.\" The gate refutes that. What is\n294\t  constant is the B-floor; the edges are weather.\n295\t\n296\t- **Contemporaneous, not sequential.** This is the defensible sense of \"atemporal\":\n297\t  the directed lead-lag flow is *below* a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`,\n298\t  z about -6). Adjacent snapshots are nearly identical, so the coupling is symmetric\n299\t  and simultaneous rather than a directed temporal sequence. The observatory reads a\n300\t  standing valuation; it does not forecast. Standing does not mean unchanging.\n301\t\n302\t- **The coupling object is broadcast, not lagged.** The earlier Pearson lag-coupler\n303\t  emitted one-directional edges at nonzero lag (the widely quoted lambda=16469s,\n304\t  r=1.000). Those are degenerate: on saturated low-variance alert series Pearson\n305\t  snaps to r = +/-1, and the coupler could not represent a one-to-all contradiction.\n306\t  The honest object is the signed broadcast fan (`ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`):\n307\t  each channel's simultaneous, both-sign coupling to all others. It recovers genuine\n308\t  both-sign forks (a channel positive with one partner and negative with another at\n309\t  once), but they are weak, |r| ~ 0.2-0.4, and by the gate above they are epoch-local.\n310\t\n311\t- **Contradiction is still primary data.** The B-state, a stable assignment of\n312\t  Both-True-and-False, remains the fundamental unit: the confluence is real and\n313\t  replicates. What has been corrected is the strength and permanence of the specific\n314\t  edges, not the existence of the B-floor.\n315\t\n316\t## Chirality streams (25-34)\n317\t\n318\tThe 10 chirality streams measure Ħ (Chirality/handedness) across three domains:\n319\t\n320\t| Domain | Streams | What chirality is measured |\n321\t|--------|---------|---------------------------|\n322\t| Biological | genbank, pubmed, wiki_chiral, arxiv_bio, fda_enforce | L-amino acid / D-sugar prevalence, chiral molecule reports, enantiomeric drug enforcement |\n323\t| Astrophysical integral | stereo_cr, ace_epam, goes_cr | Galactic cosmic ray e⁻/p⁺ ratios; magnetic field polarity via particle drift patterns |\n324\t| Astrophysical directional | dscovr_helicity, stereo_sept | IMF Bz helicity proxy; directional e⁻/p⁺ fluxes resolving Parker spiral handedness |\n325\t\n326\tThese streams provide empirical ground truth for Ħ (Chirality) -- the Markov-order\n327\tprimitive that, under Axiom A of the Imscribing Grammar (Ħ_∞ -> 𐑪), requires\n328\tsaturation of chirality depth before kinetic gating closes.\n329\t\n330\t## Extraplanetary streams (39-44)\n331\t\n332\tThe extraplanetary tier extends coverage from near-Earth heliophysics to the\n333\tobservable universe:\n334\t\n335\t- **polar_geomag (39)** -- NOAA OVATION per-coordinate aurora forecast merged with\n336\t  SWPC G-scale storm alerts. North/south pole asymmetry is a direct Φ (Parity) signal;\n337\t  oval expansion is Ω (Winding); storm G-level gates ⊙ (Criticality).\n338\t\n339\t- **neutron_monitor (40)** -- NMDB Oulu galactic cosmic ray neutron count; Forbush\n340\t  decrease (CME shielding) = Ħ (Chirality) + Ω (Winding). The\n350\t  spacetime metric perturbation is Ω (Winding) at cosmological scale; the\n351\t  multi-messenger coincidence architecture is ⊙ (Criticality).\n352\t\n353\t- **fermi_grb (43)** -- Fermi GBM gamma-ray burst triggers. Density = Σ (Stoichiometry); variability at 1 AU = Ç (Kinetics).\n358\t## SIC-POVM convergence\n359\t\n360\tThe observatory uses a d=12 SIC-POVM as its measurement frame over the 12 primitive\n361\tdimensions. Stated explicitly, because this section is often read first and often fed\n362\tto a model first: the frame is a genuine d=12 SIC (numerically exact), but the\n363\t44-stream apparatus is a partial, heteroskedastic POVM, not informationally complete.\n364\t\n365\t**Fiducial overlap** (Weidmann formula):\n366\t\n367\t```\n368\tmin_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\n369\tmax_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\n370\tF/F* = 1.000000\n371\t```\n372\t\n373\t**SIC overlap spectrum** (144 equiangular lines, chi2 vs uniform):\n374\t\n375\t```\n376\tObserved:  1×0.000, 2×0.083, ... 0×uniform, ... 144×0.083\n377\tExpected:  144×0.083 (uniform)\n378\tchi2 = 4.68, dof = 143, p = 1.00\n379\t```\n380\t\n381\tA chi2 of 4.68 (dof 143, p ~= 1.00) means the average state is statistically indistinguishable from the maximally mixed I/12. That is a consistency check, not a completeness proof: indistinguishable-from-uniform is equally what maximal ignorance looks like. Of the 144 SIC elements, 24 are directly addressed by current stream products, 108 are synthesisable, and 12 need new physical sources (`ig-docs/physics/sic_povm_convergence.md` sec 3.2). The apparatus is heteroskedastic, with a stated path to full SIC symmetry; it is not yet informationally complete.\n382\t\n383\t**Average density matrix** (alert-weighted, B-state baseline):\n384\t\n385\t| Metric | Measured | Ideal (I/12) |\n386\t|--------|----------|--------------|\n387\t| Purity | 0.119 | 0.083 |\n388\t| Von Neumann entropy | 2.275 | ln(12) = 2.485 |\n389\t| Frobenius dist to I/12 | 0.188 | 0 |\n390\t\n391\tThe 43% excess purity over the B-state ideal reflects which physical domains are most active in the current measurement epoch: chirality (Ħ) and coupling (ɢ) lead the diagonal with approximately double the uniform weight, while recognition (Ř) and granularity (Γ) are underweighted. Two things must be kept apart, and the out-of-sample gate (`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them. What is invariant is the native-B floor: the confluence over-disperses about 3.4x against an independence null and replicates on unseen data. What is not invariant is the wiring: the coupling graph is contemporaneous (not a directed time-sequence) but non-stationary, a now-map rather than a fixed lattice.\n\n**How to use it.** See Architecture below for the stream configuration and run commands.\n\n## What it does\n\nForty-four domain streams -- spanning market microstructure, space weather,\ngeophysics, atmospheric chemistry, biological chirality, astrophysical particle\nfluxes, and gravitational-wave astronomy -- each map to specific IG primitive\nfamilies. When primitives co-activate across streams simultaneously, a **B-state\nevent** occurs (B = Both in Belnap FOUR logic: a dialetheic confluence where\nmultiple structural channels converge).\n\nig-pulse captures these events and asks: which stream fired which primitive first?\nWhat are the lag times? Which systems are coupled to which, at what strength, and in\nwhat structural order?\n\nThe answer is an empirical map of how our-scale reality couples across domains.\nThe coupling is contemporaneous rather than a directed time-sequence: the lead-lag\nflow between channels sits **below** a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`), so\nthe system reads a standing valuation rather than forecasting. But standing is not\nunchanging. The native-B confluence is invariant and replicates out-of-sample,\nwhile the specific coupling graph is non-stationary. See \"What is invariant, and\nwhat is not\" below.\n\n## Architecture\n\n```\n┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         44 DOMAIN STREAMS                              │\n│  All public APIs -- no keys required                                  │\n├──────────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────────┬──────────────┤\n│ BASE (1-16)      │ │\n│ coingecko        │ yield_curve      │ pubmed           │ ace_epam     │\n│ onchain          │ vix              │ wiki_chiral      │ goes_cr      │\n│ tides            │ shipping         │    │ gdelt            ├──────────────────┴──────────────┤\n│ seismic_network  │ twitter          │ SIC-POVM FILL (35-38)          │\n│ kp_index         │                  │ wiki_entropy, bgp_routing       │\n│ hn_sentiment     │                  │ arxiv_ai, btc_spread            │\n│ solar_wind       │                  ├─────────────────────────────────┤\n│ lightning        │                  │ EXTRAPLANETARY (39-44)          │\n│ wikipedia        │                  │ polar_geomag, neutron_monitor   │\n│ weather          │                  │ goes_xrs, ligo_gw               │\n│ coingecko_alts   │                  │ fermi_grb, dscovr_plasma        │\n└──────────────────┴──────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────┘\n         │\n         ▼\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  DomainStreamAggregator → DomainSignal (44 streams x primitives)       │\n│  Threshold → Alert Levels 0/1/2                                        │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n         │\n         ▼\n┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  Pipeline: collect → couple → map → report                             │\n│  snapshots.jsonl → coupling.json → graph.json → B-state report         │\n└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Pipeline stages\n\n1. **collect** -- `DomainStreamAggregator` fetches all 44 streams via public APIs\n   (no keys required). Each stream's raw values are thresholded into IG primitive\n   alert levels (0/1/2). A `DomainSignal` aggregates all primitive alerts for one\n   observation cycle. Writes one `Snapshot` per cycle to `snapshots.jsonl`.\n\n2. **couple** -- Computes Pearson cross-correlation between all (stream, primitive)\n   alert time series at lags 0 to max_lag. Only edges with |r| >= min_r and p <= max_p   are retained. Saves to `coupling.json`.\n\n3. **map** -- Renders the coupling graph as an ASCII adjacency matrix (primitives\n   as edge labels), or as Graphviz DOT for rendering. Nodes are (stream, primitive)\n   pairs. Saves to `graph.json`.\n\n4. **report** -- For a given B-state snapshot timestamp, reconstructs the propagation\n   anatomy: the first activation time of each (stream, primitive) pair in the lookback\n   window, ordered as a topological traversal of the implication tree.\n\n## Stream to primitive mapping\n\nEach stream maps to specific IG primitives through threshold-based alert rules\n(0 = nominal, 1 = mild, 2 = strong):\n\n### Base streams (1-16)\n\n| # multiplier acts as a **topological mass coefficient** -- it scales the\nstructural significance of nodes participating in dialetheic intersections:\n\n| Alerts | Multiplier | Interpretation |\n|--------|-----------|----------------|\n| 0 | 1.00x | Nominal -- no primitive channel active |\n| 1 | 1.20x | Single primitive -- isolated activation |\n| 2 | 1.35x | Dual primitive -- paired activation |\n| >=3 | 1.50x | **B-state** -- dialetheic confluence |\n\nA B-state is not an \"error\" or \"anomaly.\" It is the mathematical signature of a node\nin the adjacency matrix where orthogonal domain rules overlap, assigned the Belnap\nvalue **B** (Both True and False) -- a stable fixed point of the FDE bi-lattice.\n\n## Usage\n\n```bash\n# Collect one snapshot now\npython -m ig_pulse.cli collect --once\n\n# Run continuously (hourly, matching synfin cadence)\npython -m ig_pulse.cli collect --interval 90\n\n# Compute cross-stream coupling after enough data accumulates\n# (need >=20 snapshots; ~336 = 2 weeks hourly for robust results)\npython -m ig_pulse.cli couple\n# Options: --max-lag 259200 --min-r 0.3 --max-p 0.05\n\n# Display coupling graph as ASCII adjacency matrix\npython -m ig_pulse.cli map\n\n# Display as Graphviz DOT (for rendering with dot/neato)\npython -m ig_pulse.cli map --dot\n\n# Reconstruct propagation anatomy for a B-state event\npython -m ig_pulse.cli report --ts 2026-06-22T00:03:25Z\n\n# Report on latest snapshot\npython -m ig_pulse.cli report\n```\n\n## Data format\n\n### `data/snapshots.jsonl`\n\nAppend-only JSON lines, one `Snapshot` per collection cycle:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ts\": \"2026-06-22T04:38:43Z\",\n  \"multiplier\": 1.50,\n  \"total_alerts\": 10,\n  \"is_b_state\": true,\n  \"primitives\": {\n    \"criticality\": 1, \"parity\": 1, \"topology\": 1,\n    \"coupling\": 2, \"dimensionality\": 1, \"stoichiometry\": 1,\n    \"winding\": 2, \"chirality\": 1\n  },\n  \"readings\": [\n    {\"stream\": \"fear_greed\", \"primitive\": \"criticality\", \"value\": 18.0, \"unit\": \"index\", \"alert\": 1},\n    {\"stream\": \"seismic\", \"primitive\": \"topology\", \"value\": 0.42, \"unit\": \"index\", \"alert\": 1},\n    {\"stream\": \"stereo_sept\", \"primitive\": \"chirality\", \"value\": 0.059, \"unit\": \"e- spectral\", \"alert\": 1}\n  ],\n  \"errors\": []\n}\n```\n\nThe `primitives` field sums alert levels per primitive across all streams.\nA primitive at level 2 from one stream and level 1 from another gives a total of 3.\nThe 12 primitive keys are: `criticality`, `parity`, `kinetics`, `topology`, `coupling`,\n`dimensionality`, `stoichiometry`, `granularity`, `winding`, `chirality`, `recognition`,\n`fidelity`.\n\n### `data/coupling.json`\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"source_stream\": \"fear_greed\",\n    \"source_primitive\": \"criticality\",\n    \"target_stream\": \"seismic\",\n    \"target_primitive\": \"topology\",\n    \"lag_seconds\": 16469,\n    \"strength_r\": 1.0000,\n    \"p_value\": 0.0000\n  }\n]\n```\n\n### `data/graph.json`\n\nNodes (with stream, primitive, glyph symbol) and edges (with lag_seconds, strength_r,\np_value) for rendering.\n## What is invariant, and what is not\n\nTwo claims must be kept apart, because the out-of-sample gate\n(`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them and only one survives. Fit the\ncalibration and the coupling structure on the earlier portion of the stream, then\ntest on the later, unseen portion.\n\n- **Invariant: the native-B floor.** The confluence replicates. Active-channel\n  count runs about 3.4x over-dispersed against an independence null in both halves,\n  each calibrated only on itself (`ig_pulse/dialetheia.py`). Our-scale reality does\n  not resolve into isolated single-channel states; when it moves, it floods. That\n  is the stable result.\n\n- **Not invariant: the wiring.** The coupling graph is non-stationary. Fit the\n  residual coupling on the earlier half and it does not transfer to the later half\n  (full-matrix correlation about +0.1, both-sign forks about -0.05; PC1's own share\n  moves from ~15% to ~30%). The adjacency matrix is a now-map, not a fixed law.\n  Earlier drafts of this README called it an \"unchanging adjacency matrix\" with\n  \"edge invariants\" and \"structural constants.\" The gate refutes that. What is\n  constant is the B-floor; the edges are weather.\n\n- **Contemporaneous, not sequential.** This is the defensible sense of \"atemporal\":\n  the directed lead-lag flow is *below* a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`,\n  z about -6). Adjacent snapshots are nearly identical, so the coupling is symmetric\n  and simultaneous rather than a directed temporal sequence. The observatory reads a\n  standing valuation; it does not forecast. Standing does not mean unchanging.\n\n- **The coupling object is broadcast, not lagged.** The earlier Pearson lag-coupler\n  emitted one-directional edges at nonzero lag (the widely quoted lambda=16469s,\n  r=1.000). Those are degenerate: on saturated low-variance alert series Pearson\n  snaps to r = +/-1, and the coupler could not represent a one-to-all contradiction.\n  The honest object is the signed broadcast fan (`ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`):\n  each channel's simultaneous, both-sign coupling to all others. It recovers genuine\n  both-sign forks (a channel positive with one partner and negative with another at\n  once), but they are weak, |r| ~ 0.2-0.4, and by the gate above they are epoch-local.\n\n- **Contradiction is still primary data.** The B-state, a stable assignment of\n  Both-True-and-False, remains the fundamental unit: the confluence is real and\n  replicates. What has been corrected is the strength and permanence of the specific\n  edges, not the existence of the B-floor.\n\n## Chirality streams (25-34)\n\nThe 10 chirality streams measure Ħ (Chirality/handedness) across three domains:\n\n| Domain | Streams | What chirality is measured |\n|--------|---------|---------------------------|\n| Biological | genbank, pubmed, wiki_chiral, arxiv_bio, fda_enforce | L-amino acid / D-sugar prevalence, chiral molecule reports, enantiomeric drug enforcement |\n| Astrophysical integral | stereo_cr, ace_epam, goes_cr | Galactic cosmic ray e⁻/p⁺ ratios; magnetic field polarity via particle drift patterns |\n| Astrophysical directional | dscovr_helicity, stereo_sept | IMF Bz helicity proxy; directional e⁻/p⁺ fluxes resolving Parker spiral handedness |\n\nThese streams provide empirical ground truth for Ħ (Chirality) -- the Markov-order\nprimitive that, under Axiom A of the Imscribing Grammar (Ħ_∞ -> 𐑪), requires\nsaturation of chirality depth before kinetic gating closes.\n\n## Extraplanetary streams (39-44)\n\nThe extraplanetary tier extends coverage from near-Earth heliophysics to the\nobservable universe:\n\n- **polar_geomag (39)** -- NOAA OVATION per-coordinate aurora forecast merged with\n  SWPC G-scale storm alerts. North/south pole asymmetry is a direct Φ (Parity) signal;\n  oval expansion is Ω (Winding); storm G-level gates ⊙ (Criticality).\n\n- **neutron_monitor (40)** -- NMDB Oulu galactic cosmic ray neutron count; Forbush\n  decrease (CME shielding) = Ħ (Chirality) + Ω (Winding). Falls back to GOES SEP\n  flux when NMDB is unreachable.\n\n- **goes_xrs (41)** -- GOES XRS-B (0.1-0.8 nm) continuous coronal X-ray flux.\n  Unlike DONKI (event classifier), this is the raw photon flux -- the continuous\n  Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy flux through the solar corona, gating Φ (Parity) and\n  ⊙ (Criticality) at the millisecond scale where DONKI sees daily aggregates.\n\n- **ligo_gw (42)** -- LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA gravitational-wave candidate events from\n  GraceDB. Each candidate carries a false-alarm rate (FAR) and distance. The\n  spacetime metric perturbation is Ω (Winding) at cosmological scale; the\n  multi-messenger coincidence architecture is ⊙ (Criticality).\n\n- **fermi_grb (43)** -- Fermi GBM gamma-ray burst triggers. The burst itself is\n  ⊙ (Criticality); the jet/counterjet asymmetry is Φ (Parity).\n\n- **dscovr_plasma (44)** -- DSCOVR Faraday cup solar wind proton density and\n  temperature. Density = Σ (Stoichiometry); variability at 1 AU = Ç (Kinetics).\n## SIC-POVM convergence\n\nThe observatory uses a d=12 SIC-POVM as its measurement frame over the 12 primitive\ndimensions. Stated explicitly, because this section is often read first and often fed\nto a model first: the frame is a genuine d=12 SIC (numerically exact), but the\n44-stream apparatus is a partial, heteroskedastic POVM, not informationally complete.\n\n**Fiducial overlap** (Weidmann formula):\n\n```\nmin_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\nmax_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\nF/F* = 1.000000\n```\n\n**SIC overlap spectrum** (144 equiangular lines, chi2 vs uniform):\n\n```\nObserved:  1×0.000, 2×0.083, ... 0×uniform, ... 144×0.083\nExpected:  144×0.083 (uniform)\nchi2 = 4.68, dof = 143, p = 1.00\n```\n\nA chi2 of 4.68 (dof 143, p ~= 1.00) means the average state is statistically indistinguishable from the maximally mixed I/12. That is a consistency check, not a completeness proof: indistinguishable-from-uniform is equally what maximal ignorance looks like. Of the 144 SIC elements, 24 are directly addressed by current stream products, 108 are synthesisable, and 12 need new physical sources (`ig-docs/physics/sic_povm_convergence.md` sec 3.2). The apparatus is heteroskedastic, with a stated path to full SIC symmetry; it is not yet informationally complete.\n\n**Average density matrix** (alert-weighted, B-state baseline):\n\n| Metric | Measured | Ideal (I/12) |\n|--------|----------|--------------|\n| Purity | 0.119 | 0.083 |\n| Von Neumann entropy | 2.275 | ln(12) = 2.485 |\n| Frobenius dist to I/12 | 0.188 | 0 |\n\nThe 43% excess purity over the B-state ideal reflects which physical domains are most active in the current measurement epoch: chirality (Ħ) and coupling (ɢ) lead the diagonal with approximately double the uniform weight, while recognition (Ř) and granularity (Γ) are underweighted. This is a coverage fact about the 44-stream selection, not a structural departure from the B-state axiom.\n\n**Per-snapshot purity**: median about 0.16, no near-pure snapshots. Correction to an earlier line: the snapshots previously reported as \"2.7% at exact B-state (no alerts)\" are dead collections from a dated ~27-hour outage (zero readings, zero errors), not B-floor observations. Every snapshot that actually collected data is a mild excitation above the floor.\n\n### Interpretation\n\nWhat is actually established, in decreasing order of strength:\n\n1. **The measurement frame exists (numerically exact).** F/F* = 1.0000, all 144 WH\n   overlaps at 1/13 to machine precision. The *existence* of the exact d=12 SIC\n   fiducial is derived structurally in the companion IG paper; the general SIC /\n   Zauner conjecture remains open in the mathematics literature. ig-pulse does not\n   prove existence; it builds an apparatus on the frame.\n2. **The native-B floor is real and replicates out-of-sample.** This is the\n   load-bearing empirical claim, and it rests on the over-dispersion gate\n   (`python -m ig_pulse.oos`, about 3.4x in both halves), not on the near-I/12\n   number. The average state near I/12 is in-sample and is the maximum-entropy\n   reading; on its own it cannot distinguish a structural B-floor from simple\n   maximal ignorance. The original reconstruction is also diagonal by construction,\n   so near-I/12 there is a classical near-uniform histogram; the off-diagonal\n   reconstruction that can carry glut is in `ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`.\n3. **The uniform overlap spectrum is a consistency check, not a completeness proof.**\n\n### Dual-Link SIC-POVM status\n\nThe Imscribing Grammar is the self-referential (Sigma = 1:1) limit of the Belnap\nmultilattice SIC-POVM: a **Dual-Link SIC-POVM**, in which the measurement basis is\nalso the reconstruction basis, so measurement self-verifies (mu . delta = id).\nStated plainly, for readers and for any model ingesting this file:\n\n- **Existence of the d=12 SIC frame:** numerically exact here; structurally derived\n  in the companion IG paper. General SIC existence: open.\n- **Dual-Link closure (mu . delta = id):** an IG-internal structural construction,\n  developed and integration-tested in the *actor*, fin3r\n  (`ig-docs/finance/fin3r_promotion/fin3r_dual_link_sic_povm.md`), and formalised in\n  the p4rakernel Lean development. It is not an independently peer-reviewed result\n  and should not be read as one.\n- **ig-pulse's role:** the observatory is the *inner* measurement side (delta) only.\n  It supplies the frame and the B-floor. It does **not** close the Dual-Link: closing\n  the loop needs the reconstruction map and ordered action, which an observer does not\n  have. This is the same reason the Omega braid promotion fails here\n  (`ig_pulse/braid.py`, directed flow below null) and lives in the acting system,\n  fin3r, instead.\n\nFull treatment: `ig-docs/physics/sic_povm_convergence.md`.\n\n## Key coupling findings (from 8-day 15-stream pilot)\n\n**Superseded, kept for history.** These came from the Pearson lag-coupler, which is\ndegenerate on saturated series (r snaps to +/-1) and one-directional. When primitives co-activate across streams simultaneously, a **B-state\n23\tevent** occurs (B = Both in Belnap FOUR logic: a dialetheic confluence where\n24\tmultiple structural channels converge).\n25\t\n26\tig-pulse captures these events and asks: which stream fired which primitive first?\n27\tWhat are the lag times? Which systems are coupled to which, at what strength, and in\n28\twhat structural order?\n29\t\n30\tThe answer is an empirical map of how our-scale reality couples across domains.\n31\tThe coupling is contemporaneous rather than a directed time-sequence: the lead-lag\n32\tflow between channels sits **below** a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`), so\n33\tthe system reads a standing valuation rather than forecasting. schedule\n181\t\n182\tThe B-state multiplier acts as a **topological mass coefficient** -- it scales the\n183\tstructural significance of nodes participating in dialetheic intersections:\n184\t\n185\t| Alerts | Multiplier | Interpretation |\n186\t|--------|-----------|----------------|\n187\t| 0 | 1.00x | Nominal -- no primitive channel active |\n188\t| 1 | 1.20x | Single primitive -- isolated activation |\n189\t| 2 | 1.35x | Dual primitive -- paired activation |\n190\t| >=3 | 1.50x | **B-state** -- dialetheic confluence |\n191\t\n192\tA B-state is not an \"error\" or \"anomaly.\" It is the mathematical signature of a node\n193\tin the adjacency matrix where orthogonal domain rules overlap, assigned the Belnap\n194\tvalue **B** (Both True and False) -- a stable fixed point of the FDE bi-lattice.\n195\t\n196\t## Usage\n197\t\n198\t```bash\n199\t# Collect one snapshot now\n200\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli collect --once\n201\t\n202\t# Run continuously (hourly, matching synfin cadence)\n203\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli collect --interval 90\n204\t\n205\t# Compute cross-stream coupling after enough data accumulates\n206\t# (need >=20 snapshots; ~336 = 2 weeks hourly for robust results)\n207\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli couple\n208\t# Options: --max-lag 259200 --min-r 0.3 --max-p 0.05\n209\t\n210\t# Display coupling graph as ASCII adjacency matrix\n211\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli map\n212\t\n213\t# Display as Graphviz DOT (for rendering with dot/neato)\n214\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli map --dot\n215\t\n216\t# Reconstruct propagation anatomy for a B-state event\n217\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli report --ts 2026-06-22T00:03:25Z\n218\t\n219\t# Report on latest snapshot\n220\tpython -m ig_pulse.cli report\n221\t```\n222\t\n223\t## Data format\n224\t\n225\t### `data/snapshots.jsonl`\n226\t\n227\tAppend-only JSON lines, one `Snapshot` per collection cycle:\n228\t\n229\t```json\n230\t{\n231\t  \"ts\": \"2026-06-22T04:38:43Z\",\n232\t  \"multiplier\": 1.50,\n233\t  \"total_alerts\": 10,\n234\t  \"is_b_state\": true,\n235\t  \"primitives\": {\n236\t    \"criticality\": 1, \"parity\": 1, \"topology\": 1,\n237\t    \"coupling\": 2, \"dimensionality\": 1, \"stoichiometry\": 1,\n238\t    \"winding\": 2, \"chirality\": 1\n239\t  },\n240\t  \"readings\": [\n241\t    {\"stream\": \"fear_greed\", \"primitive\": \"criticality\", \"value\": 18.0, \"unit\": \"index\", \"alert\": 1},\n242\t    {\"stream\": \"seismic\", \"primitive\": \"topology\", \"value\": 0.42, \"unit\": \"index\", \"alert\": 1},\n243\t    {\"stream\": \"stereo_sept\", \"primitive\": \"chirality\", \"value\": 0.059, \"unit\": \"e- spectral\", \"alert\": 1}\n244\t  ],\n245\t  \"errors\": []\n246\t}\n247\t```\n248\t\n249\tThe `primitives` field sums alert levels per primitive across all streams.\n250\tA primitive at level 2 from one stream and level 1 from another gives a total of 3.\n251\tThe 12 primitive keys are: `criticality`, `parity`, `kinetics`, `topology`, `coupling`,\n252\t`dimensionality`, `stoichiometry`, `granularity`, `winding`, `chirality`, `recognition`,\n253\t`fidelity`.\n254\t\n255\t### `data/coupling.json`\n256\t\n257\t```json\n258\t[\n259\t  {\n260\t    \"source_stream\": \"fear_greed\",\n261\t    \"source_primitive\": \"criticality\",\n262\t    \"target_stream\": \"seismic\",\n263\t    \"target_primitive\": \"topology\",\n264\t    \"lag_seconds\": 16469,\n265\t    \"strength_r\": 1.0000,\n266\t    \"p_value\": 0.0000\n267\t  }\n268\t]\n269\t```\n270\t\n271\t### `data/graph.json`\n272\t\n273\tNodes (with stream, primitive, glyph symbol) and edges (with lag_seconds, strength_r,\n274\tp_value) for rendering.\n275\t## What is invariant, and what is not\n276\t\n277\tTwo claims must be kept apart, because the out-of-sample gate\n278\t(`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them and only one survives. Fit the\n279\tcalibration and the coupling structure on the earlier portion of the stream, then\n280\ttest on the later, unseen portion.\n281\t\n282\t- **Invariant: the native-B floor.** The confluence replicates. Active-channel\n283\t  count runs about 3.4x over-dispersed against an independence null in both halves,\n284\t  each calibrated only on itself (`ig_pulse/dialetheia.py`). Our-scale reality does\n285\t  not resolve into isolated single-channel states; when it moves, it floods. That\n286\t  is the stable result.\n287\t\n288\t- **Not invariant: the wiring.** The coupling graph is non-stationary. Fit the\n289\t  residual coupling on the earlier half and it does not transfer to the later half\n290\t  (full-matrix correlation about +0.1, both-sign forks about -0.05; PC1's own share\n291\t  moves from ~15% to ~30%). The adjacency matrix is a now-map, not a fixed law.\n292\t  Earlier drafts of this README called it an \"unchanging adjacency matrix\" with\n293\t  \"edge invariants\" and \"structural constants.\" The gate refutes that. What is\n294\t  constant is the B-floor; the edges are weather.\n295\t\n296\t- **Contemporaneous, not sequential.** This is the defensible sense of \"atemporal\":\n297\t  the directed lead-lag flow is *below* a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`,\n298\t  z about -6). Adjacent snapshots are nearly identical, so the coupling is symmetric\n299\t  and simultaneous rather than a directed temporal sequence. The observatory reads a\n300\t  standing valuation; it does not forecast. Standing does not mean unchanging.\n301\t\n302\t- **The coupling object is broadcast, not lagged.** The earlier Pearson lag-coupler\n303\t  emitted one-directional edges at nonzero lag (the widely quoted lambda=16469s,\n304\t  r=1.000). Those are degenerate: on saturated low-variance alert series Pearson\n305\t  snaps to r = +/-1, and the coupler could not represent a one-to-all contradiction.\n306\t  The honest object is the signed broadcast fan (`ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`):\n307\t  each channel's simultaneous, both-sign coupling to all others. It recovers genuine\n308\t  both-sign forks (a channel positive with one partner and negative with another at\n309\t  once), but they are weak, |r| ~ 0.2-0.4, and by the gate above they are epoch-local.\n310\t\n311\t- **Contradiction is still primary data.** The B-state, a stable assignment of\n312\t  Both-True-and-False, remains the fundamental unit: the confluence is real and\n313\t  replicates. What has been corrected is the strength and permanence of the specific\n314\t  edges, not the existence of the B-floor.\n315\t\n316\t## Chirality streams (25-34)\n317\t\n318\tThe 10 chirality streams measure Ħ (Chirality/handedness) across three domains:\n319\t\n320\t| Domain | Streams | What chirality is measured |\n321\t|--------|---------|---------------------------|\n322\t| Biological | genbank, pubmed, wiki_chiral, arxiv_bio, fda_enforce | L-amino acid / D-sugar prevalence, chiral molecule reports, enantiomeric drug enforcement |\n323\t| Astrophysical integral | stereo_cr, ace_epam, goes_cr | Galactic cosmic ray e⁻/p⁺ ratios; magnetic field polarity via particle drift patterns |\n324\t| Astrophysical directional | dscovr_helicity, stereo_sept | IMF Bz helicity proxy; directional e⁻/p⁺ fluxes resolving Parker spiral handedness |\n325\t\n326\tThese streams provide empirical ground truth for Ħ (Chirality) -- the Markov-order\n327\tprimitive that, under Axiom A of the Imscribing Grammar (Ħ_∞ -> 𐑪), requires\n328\tsaturation of chirality depth before kinetic gating closes.\n329\t\n330\t## Extraplanetary streams (39-44)\n331\t\n332\tThe extraplanetary tier extends coverage from near-Earth heliophysics to the\n333\tobservable universe:\n334\t\n335\t- **polar_geomag (39)** -- NOAA OVATION per-coordinate aurora forecast merged with\n336\t  SWPC G-scale storm alerts. North/south pole asymmetry is a direct Φ (Parity) signal;\n337\t  oval expansion is Ω (Winding); storm G-level gates ⊙ (Criticality).\n338\t\n339\t- **neutron_monitor (40)** -- NMDB Oulu galactic cosmic ray neutron count; Forbush\n340\t  decrease (CME shielding) = Ħ (Chirality) + Ω (Winding). Falls back to GOES SEP\n341\t  flux when NMDB is unreachable.\n342\t\n343\t- **goes_xrs (41)** -- GOES XRS-B (0.1-0.8 nm) continuous coronal X-ray flux.\n344\t  Unlike DONKI (event classifier), this is the raw photon flux -- the continuous\n345\t  Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy flux through the solar corona, gating Φ (Parity) and\n346\t  ⊙ (Criticality) at the millisecond scale where DONKI sees daily aggregates.\n347\t\n348\t- **ligo_gw (42)** -- LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA gravitational-wave candidate events from\n349\t  GraceDB. Each candidate carries a false-alarm rate (FAR) and distance. The\n350\t  spacetime metric perturbation is Ω (Winding) at cosmological scale; the\n351\t  multi-messenger coincidence architecture is ⊙ (Criticality).\n352\t\n353\t- **fermi_grb (43)** -- Fermi GBM gamma-ray burst triggers. The burst itself is\n354\t  ⊙ (Criticality); the jet/counterjet asymmetry is Φ (Parity).\n355\t\n356\t- **dscovr_plasma (44)** -- DSCOVR Faraday cup solar wind proton density and\n357\t  temperature. Density = Σ (Stoichiometry); variability at 1 AU = Ç (Kinetics).\n358\t## SIC-POVM convergence\n359\t\n360\tThe observatory uses a d=12 SIC-POVM as its measurement frame over the 12 primitive\n361\tdimensions. Stated explicitly, because this section is often read first and often fed\n362\tto a model first: the frame is a genuine d=12 SIC (numerically exact), but the\n363\t44-stream apparatus is a partial, heteroskedastic POVM, not informationally complete.\n364\t\n365\t**Fiducial overlap** (Weidmann formula):\n366\t\n367\t```\n368\tmin_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\n369\tmax_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\n370\tF/F* = 1.000000\n371\t```\n372\t\n373\t**SIC overlap spectrum** (144 equiangular lines, chi2 vs uniform):\n374\t\n375\t```\n376\tObserved:  1×0.000, 2×0.083, ... 0×uniform, ... 144×0.083\n377\tExpected:  144×0.083 (uniform)\n378\tchi2 = 4.68, dof = 143, p = 1.00\n379\t```\n380\t\n381\tA chi2 of 4.68 (dof 143, p ~= 1.00) means the average state is statistically indistinguishable from the maximally mixed I/12. That is a consistency check, not a completeness proof: indistinguishable-from-uniform is equally what maximal ignorance looks like. Of the 144 SIC elements, 24 are directly addressed by current stream products, 108 are synthesisable, and 12 need new physical sources (`ig-docs/physics/sic_povm_convergence.md` sec 3.2). The apparatus is heteroskedastic, with a stated path to full SIC symmetry; it is not yet informationally complete.\n382\t\n383\t**Average density matrix** (alert-weighted, B-state baseline):\n384\t\n385\t| Metric | Measured | Ideal (I/12) |\n386\t|--------|----------|--------------|\n387\t| Purity | 0.119 | 0.083 |\n388\t| Von Neumann entropy | 2.275 | ln(12) = 2.485 |\n389\t| Frobenius dist to I/12 | 0.188 | 0 |\n390\t\n391\tThe 43% excess purity over the B-state ideal reflects which physical domains are most active in the current measurement epoch: chirality (Ħ) and coupling (ɢ) lead the diagonal with approximately double the uniform weight, while recognition (Ř) and granularity (Γ) are underweighted. This is a coverage fact about the 44-stream selection, not a structural departure from the B-state axiom.\n392\t\n393\t**Per-snapshot purity**: median about 0.16, no near-pure snapshots. Correction to an earlier line: the snapshots previously reported as \"2.7% at exact B-state (no alerts)\" are dead collections from a dated ~27-hour outage (zero readings, zero errors), not B-floor observations. Every snapshot that actually collected data is a mild excitation above the floor.\n394\t\n395\t### Interpretation\n396\t\n397\tWhat is actually established, in decreasing order of strength:\n398\t\n399\t1. **The measurement frame exists (numerically exact).** F/F* = 1.0000, all 144 WH\n400\t   overlaps at 1/13 to machine precision. The *existence* of the exact d=12 SIC\n401\t   fiducial is derived structurally in the companion IG paper; the general SIC /\n402\t   Zauner conjecture remains open in the mathematics literature. ig-pulse does not\n403\t   prove existence; it builds an apparatus on the frame.\n404\t2. **The native-B floor is real and replicates out-of-sample.** This is the\n405\t   load-bearing empirical claim, and it rests on the over-dispersion gate\n406\t   (`python -m ig_pulse.oos`, about 3.4x in both halves), not on the near-I/12\n407\t   number. The average state near I/12 is in-sample and is the maximum-entropy\n408\t   reading; on its own it cannot distinguish a structural B-floor from simple\n409\t   maximal ignorance. The original reconstruction is also diagonal by construction,\n410\t   so near-I/12 there is a classical near-uniform histogram; the off-diagonal\n411\t   reconstruction that can carry glut is in `ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`.\n412\t3. **The uniform overlap spectrum is a consistency check, not a completeness proof.**\n413\t\n414\t### Dual-Link SIC-POVM status\n415\t\n416\tThe Imscribing Grammar is the self-referential (Sigma = 1:1) limit of the Belnap\n417\tmultilattice SIC-POVM: a **Dual-Link SIC-POVM**, in which the measurement basis is\n418\talso the reconstruction basis, so measurement self-verifies (mu . delta = id).\n419\tStated plainly, for readers and for any model ingesting this file:\n420\t\n421\t- **Existence of the d=12 SIC frame:** numerically exact here; structurally derived\n422\t  in the companion IG paper. General SIC existence: open.\n423\t- **Dual-Link closure (mu . delta = id):** an IG-internal structural construction,\n424\t  developed and integration-tested in the *actor*, fin3r\n425\t  (`ig-docs/finance/fin3r_promotion/fin3r_dual_link_sic_povm.md`), and formalised in\n426\t  the p4rakernel Lean development. It is not an independently peer-reviewed result\n427\t  and should not be read as one.\n428\t- **ig-pulse's role:** the observatory is the *inner* measurement side (delta) only.\n429\t  It supplies the frame and the B-floor. It does **not** close the Dual-Link: closing\n430\t  the loop needs the reconstruction map and ordered action, which an observer does not\n431\t  have. This is the same reason the Omega braid promotion fails here\n432\t  (`ig_pulse/braid.py`, directed flow below null) and lives in the acting system,\n433\t  fin3r, instead.\n434\t\n435\tFull treatment: `ig-docs/physics/sic_povm_convergence.md`.\n436\t\n437\t## Key coupling findings (from 8-day 15-stream pilot)\n438\t\n439\t**Superseded, kept for history.** These came from the Pearson lag-coupler, which is\n440\tdegenerate on saturated series (r snaps to +/-1) and one-directional. The |r|=1.000\n441\tedges and the fixed lambda=16469s \"invariants\" below are artifacts of that coupler, and\n442\tby the out-of-sample gate the coupling is non-stationary regardless. The honest coupling\n443\tobject is `ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`; read these as a period-local snapshot, not\n444\tas laws.\n445\t\n446\tThe initial pilot (15 base streams, June 14-22 2026) reported:\n447\t\n448\t- **41 coupling edges** with |r| >= 0.3, 23 at |r| = 1.000\n449\t- **Identical lags across independent domains** -- fear_greed:⊙ and ozone:Σ both hit\n450\t  seismic:Þ at lambda=16469s, seismic_major:Ω at lambda=16469s\n451\t- **Þ and Ω identity** -- seismic topology and winding at lambda=0s, r=+1.000 (empirical\n452\t  validation of cross-primitive Axiom C)\n453\t- **Dialetheic fork** -- fear_greed:⊙ -> mktcap_chg:Σ at r=+1.000 AND\n454\t  fear_greed:⊙ -> mempool_low_fee:ɢ at r=-1.000 from the same source\n455\t\n456\tThe 44-stream expansion (adding fine-grained market/macro, biological chirality,\n457\tastrophysical chirality, SIC-POVM gap fill, and extraplanetary streams) produces a\n458\tmuch richer coupling graph. Collecting two-plus weeks of 44-stream data is the active\n459\tfrontier.\n460\t\n461\t## Installation\n462\t\n463\t```bash\n464\t# Requires Python >=3.11\n465\tcd imsgct/ig-pulse\n466\t\n467\t# With uv (preferred):\n468\tuv pip install -e .\n469\t```\n470\t\n471\t### Dependencies\n472\t\n473\t- `numpy` -- time series computation\n474\t- `scipy` -- Pearson correlation with p-values\n475\t- `networkx` -- graph structure\n476\t\n477\tNo API keys required. Two things must be kept apart, and the out-of-sample gate (`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them. What is invariant is the native-B floor: the confluence over-disperses about 3.4x against an independence null and replicates on unseen data. What is not invariant is the wiring: the coupling graph is contemporaneous (not a directed time-sequence) but non-stationary, a now-map rather than a fixed lattice.\n\n**How to use it.** See Architecture below for the stream configuration and run commands.\n\n## What it does\n\nForty-four domain streams -- spanning market microstructure, space weather,\ngeophysics, atmospheric chemistry, biological chirality, astrophysical particle\nfluxes, and gravitational-wave astronomy -- each map to specific IG primitive\nfamilies. When primitives co-activate across streams simultaneously, a **B-state\nevent** occurs (B = Both in Belnap FOUR logic: a dialetheic confluence where\nmultiple structural channels converge).\n\nig-pulse captures these events and asks: which stream fired which primitive first?\nWhat are the lag times? Which systems are coupled to which, at what strength, and in\nwhat structural order?\n\nThe answer is an empirical map of how our-scale reality couples across domains.\nThe coupling is contemporaneous rather than a directed time-sequence: the lead-lag\nflow between channels sits **below** a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`), so\nthe system reads a standing valuation rather than forecasting. 44 streams via public APIs\n   (no keys required). Each stream's raw values are thresholded into IG primitive\n   alert levels (0/1/2). A `DomainSignal` aggregates all primitive alerts for one\n   observation cycle. Writes one `Snapshot` per cycle to `snapshots.jsonl`.\n\n2. **couple** -- Computes Pearson cross-correlation between all (stream, primitive)\n   alert time series at lags 0 to max_lag. Only edges with |r| >= min_r and p <= max_p   are retained. Saves to `coupling.json`.\n\n3. **map** -- Renders the coupling graph as an ASCII adjacency matrix (primitives\n   as edge labels), or as Graphviz DOT for rendering. Nodes are (stream, primitive)\n   pairs. Saves to `graph.json`.\n\n4. **report** -- For a given B-state snapshot timestamp, reconstructs the propagation\n   anatomy: the first activation time of each (stream, primitive) pair in the lookback\n   window, ordered as a topological traversal of the implication tree.\n\n## Stream to primitive mapping\n\nEach stream maps to specific IG primitives through threshold-based alert rules\n(0 = nominal, 1 = mild, 2 = strong):\n\n### Base streams (1-16)\n\n| # rendering.\n## What is invariant, and what is not\n\nTwo claims must be kept apart, because the out-of-sample gate\n(`python -m ig_pulse.oos`) separates them and only one survives. Fit the\ncalibration and the coupling structure on the earlier portion of the stream, then\ntest on the later, unseen portion.\n\n- **Invariant: the native-B floor.** The confluence replicates. Active-channel\n  count runs about 3.4x over-dispersed against an independence null in both halves,\n  each calibrated only on itself (`ig_pulse/dialetheia.py`). Our-scale reality does\n  not resolve into isolated single-channel states; when it moves, it floods. That\n  is the stable result.\n\n- **Not invariant: the wiring.** The coupling graph is non-stationary. Fit the\n  residual coupling on the earlier half and it does not transfer to the later half\n  (full-matrix correlation about +0.1, both-sign forks about -0.05; PC1's own share\n  moves from ~15% to ~30%). The adjacency matrix is a now-map, not a fixed law.\n  Earlier drafts of this README called it an \"unchanging adjacency matrix\" with\n  \"edge invariants\" and \"structural constants.\" The gate refutes that. What is\n  constant is the B-floor; the edges are weather.\n\n- **Contemporaneous, not sequential.** This is the defensible sense of \"atemporal\":\n  the directed lead-lag flow is *below* a time-shuffled null (`ig_pulse/braid.py`,\n  z about -6). Adjacent snapshots are nearly identical, so the coupling is symmetric\n  and simultaneous rather than a directed temporal sequence. The observatory reads a\n  standing valuation; it does not forecast. Standing does not mean unchanging.\n\n- **The coupling object is broadcast, not lagged.** The earlier Pearson lag-coupler\n  emitted one-directional edges at nonzero lag (the widely quoted lambda=16469s,\n  r=1.000). Those are degenerate: on saturated low-variance alert series Pearson\n  snaps to r = +/-1, and the coupler could not represent a one-to-all contradiction.\n  The honest object is the signed broadcast fan (`ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`):\n  each channel's simultaneous, both-sign coupling to all others. It recovers genuine\n  both-sign forks (a channel positive with one partner and negative with another at\n  once), but they are weak, |r| ~ 0.2-0.4, and by the gate above they are epoch-local.\n\n- **Contradiction is still primary data.** The B-state, a stable assignment of\n  Both-True-and-False, remains the fundamental unit: the confluence is real and\n  replicates. What has been corrected is the strength and permanence of the specific\n  edges, not the existence of the B-floor.\n\n## Chirality streams (25-34)\n\nThe 10 chirality streams measure Ħ (Chirality/handedness) across three domains:\n\n| Domain | Streams | What chirality is measured |\n|--------|---------|---------------------------|\n| Biological | genbank, pubmed, wiki_chiral, arxiv_bio, fda_enforce | L-amino acid / D-sugar prevalence, chiral molecule reports, enantiomeric drug enforcement |\n| Astrophysical integral | stereo_cr, ace_epam, goes_cr | Galactic cosmic ray e⁻/p⁺ ratios; magnetic field polarity via particle drift patterns |\n| Astrophysical directional | dscovr_helicity, stereo_sept | IMF Bz helicity proxy; directional e⁻/p⁺ fluxes resolving Parker spiral handedness |\n\nThese streams provide empirical ground truth for Ħ (Chirality) -- the Markov-order\nprimitive that, under Axiom A of the Imscribing Grammar (Ħ_∞ -> 𐑪), requires\nsaturation of chirality depth before kinetic gating closes.\n\n## Extraplanetary streams (39-44)\n\nThe extraplanetary tier extends coverage from near-Earth heliophysics to the\nobservable universe:\n\n- **polar_geomag (39)** -- NOAA OVATION per-coordinate aurora forecast merged with\n  SWPC G-scale storm alerts. Density = Σ (Stoichiometry); variability at 1 AU = Ç (Kinetics).\n## SIC-POVM convergence\n\nThe observatory uses a d=12 SIC-POVM as its measurement frame over the 12 primitive\ndimensions. Stated explicitly, because this section is often read first and often fed\nto a model first: the frame is a genuine d=12 SIC (numerically exact), but the\n44-stream apparatus is a partial, heteroskedastic POVM, not informationally complete.\n\n**Fiducial overlap** (Weidmann formula):\n\n```\nmin_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\nmax_j |<psi|Pi_j|psi>| = 0.08333... = 1/12\nF/F* = 1.000000\n```\n\n**SIC overlap spectrum** (144 equiangular lines, chi2 vs uniform):\n\n```\nObserved:  1×0.000, 2×0.083, ... 0×uniform, ... 144×0.083\nExpected:  144×0.083 (uniform)\nchi2 = 4.68, dof = 143, p = 1.00\n```\n\nA chi2 of 4.68 (dof 143, p ~= 1.00) means the average state is statistically indistinguishable from the maximally mixed I/12. That is a consistency check, not a completeness proof: indistinguishable-from-uniform is equally what maximal ignorance looks like. Of the 144 SIC elements, 24 are directly addressed by current stream products, 108 are synthesisable, and 12 need new physical sources (`ig-docs/physics/sic_povm_convergence.md` sec 3.2). The apparatus is heteroskedastic, with a stated path to full SIC symmetry; it is not yet informationally complete.\n\n**Average density matrix** (alert-weighted, B-state baseline):\n\n| Metric | Measured | Ideal (I/12) |\n|--------|----------|--------------|\n| Purity | 0.119 | 0.083 |\n| Von Neumann entropy | 2.275 | ln(12) = 2.485 |\n| Frobenius dist to I/12 | 0.188 | 0 |\n\nThe 43% excess purity over the B-state ideal reflects which physical domains are most active in the current measurement epoch: chirality (Ħ) and coupling (ɢ) lead the diagonal with approximately double the uniform weight, while recognition (Ř) and granularity (Γ) are underweighted. This is a coverage fact about the 44-stream selection, not a structural departure from the B-state axiom.\n\n**Per-snapshot purity**: median about 0.16, no near-pure snapshots. Correction to an earlier line: the snapshots previously reported as \"2.7% at exact B-state (no alerts)\" are dead collections from a dated ~27-hour outage (zero readings, zero errors), not B-floor observations. Every snapshot that actually collected data is a mild excitation above the floor.\n\n### Interpretation\n\nWhat is actually established, in decreasing order of strength:\n\n1. **The measurement frame exists (numerically exact).** F/F* = 1.0000, all 144 WH\n   overlaps at 1/13 to machine precision. The *existence* of the exact d=12 SIC\n   fiducial is derived structurally in the companion IG paper; the general SIC /\n   Zauner conjecture remains open in the mathematics literature. ig-pulse does not\n   prove existence; it builds an apparatus on the frame.\n2. **The native-B floor is real and replicates out-of-sample.** This is the\n   load-bearing empirical claim, and it rests on the over-dispersion gate\n   (`python -m ig_pulse.oos`, about 3.4x in both halves), not on the near-I/12\n   number. The average state near I/12 is in-sample and is the maximum-entropy\n   reading; on its own it cannot distinguish a structural B-floor from simple\n   maximal ignorance. The original reconstruction is also diagonal by construction,\n   so near-I/12 there is a classical near-uniform histogram; the off-diagonal\n   reconstruction that can carry glut is in `ig_pulse/broadcast_coupling.py`.\n3. **The uniform overlap spectrum is a consistency check, not a completeness proof.**\n\n### Dual-Link SIC-POVM status\n\nThe Imscribing Grammar is the self-referential (Sigma = 1:1) limit of the Belnap\nmultilattice SIC-POVM: a **Dual-Link SIC-POVM**, in which the measurement basis is\nalso the reconstruction basis, so measurement self-verifies (mu . delta = id).\nStated plainly, for readers and for any model ingesting this file:\n\n- **Existence of the d=12 SIC frame:** numerically exact here; structurally derived\n  in the companion IG paper.
